feedback.internal_finding: The student's formula correctly expresses the requirement that if a state contains filling, then no state anywhere above it may also contain filling. The formula uses the box operator to enforce that for every cell reachable by going down (i.e., any row above), the cell does not contain filling. This aligns with the semantic goal of a global vertical constraint.
feedback.student_feedback: Your formula correctly captures the requirement that if a state contains filling, then no state anywhere above it may also contain filling. The use of the box operator to enforce the constraint is appropriate.
feedback.suggestion: The formula could be refined to explicitly use the 'above' relation to ensure clarity in the modal logic formulation.
